about.title: About – Notefox
about.heading: About
about.p1: Notefox is a simple note-taking web extension for Firefox. It is a free and open-source project. It permits you to take notes in a simple and fast way, and it is designed to be easy to use.
about.p2: The main features of Notefox are: take notes, manage notes, search notes, export notes, import notes, sticky notes, text formatting, and more. Notefox is designed to be fast and lightweight, and it is designed to be compatible with all desktop platforms: Windows, macOS, and Linux.
about.p3: Since Notefox 4.0, it is possible to synchronize notes between devices with a Notefox Account.
about.p4: The project was born in 2021, and it is developed by Saverio Morelli. The project is developed in JavaScript, HTML and CSS, and it uses the WebExtensions API provided by Firefox and other browsers.
about.p5: Notefox is available on the Firefox Add-ons website, and it is also available on GitHub. It's available also a Chrome and Edge version of Notefox, although I suggest using Firefox!
about.p6: Many users contributed to the project by translating Notefox in their language, by suggesting new features, or by reporting bugs. I want to thank all the users that contributed to the project.
about.p7: If you want to contribute to the project, you can do it on GitHub. You can also translate Notefox in your language on Crowdin, or you can suggest new features or improvements. You can also support the project by making a donation: LiberaPay and PayPal are available.

privacy.title: Privacy policy – Notefox
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy applies to Notefox Account (the current version is v2), and to the optional Telemetry and Error logs features. If you do not use any of these, the Notefox add-on does not collect or send any data to the server.
privacy.developer_info: Notefox: websites notes is an open-source project developed by Saverio Morelli (saveriomorelli.com/contact-me), based in Italy. The service is hosted on Aruba.it servers, located in Italy.
privacy.s1_intro: Notefox Account v2 allows you to synchronize your notes across multiple devices and access them anywhere. The v2 system uses a modern encryption architecture with a Data Encryption Key (DEK) model. When using Notefox Account v2, the service collects and stores:
privacy.s1_item_email: Your email — stored only as a SHA-512 hash. The server never stores your email in plaintext; it is used solely to send verification and notification emails, then immediately discarded.
privacy.s1_item_ip: Your public IP address — stored unencrypted at account creation, at each login (in sessions), and with each sync. The IP recorded at account creation is automatically deleted after 30 days. Used for security monitoring and rate limiting.
privacy.s1_item_data: Your username and data (notes, settings, etc.) — encrypted at rest with AES-256-CBC using a per-account DEK (Data Encryption Key)
privacy.s1_encryption: Your password is never stored on the server. It is used to derive a Key Encryption Key (KEK) via PBKDF2 (SHA-256, 210,000 iterations), which wraps and unwraps the DEK. The DEK encrypts all your data across all services. Changing your password only re-wraps the DEK (~100 bytes) — your notes are never re-encrypted. If you lose or forget your password, your data cannot be recovered.
privacy.s1_retention: The service retains only your most recent synchronized data. If sync history is enabled, past versions are also retained (encrypted with the same DEK), up to a maximum of 200 versions per user; older entries are automatically pruned. IP addresses stored alongside sync data are retained for as long as the associated data exists and are permanently deleted when the account is deleted.
privacy.s1_no_cookies: The service does not use cookies and does not track users. IP addresses are collected only for security and statistical purposes, and are not shared with third parties.
privacy.s1_emails_intro: Notefox may send you emails only in the following cases:
privacy.s1_email_signup: When you sign up: to confirm your account
privacy.s1_email_created: When your account is created: confirmation message
privacy.s1_email_login: When you log in: to confirm your login (Two-Factor Authentication)
privacy.s1_email_accessed: When your account is accessed: login notification
privacy.s1_email_delete_req: When you request account deletion: confirmation email
privacy.s1_email_deleted: When your account is deleted: final confirmation
privacy.s1_no_spam: Notefox will never send spam, marketing, or promotional emails, and will never ask for your data, password, or any sensitive information.
privacy.s2_intro: If enabled, Notefox collects anonymous telemetry data about the usage of the add-on, to improve the product and fix bugs more effectively. Telemetry can be enabled with or without a Notefox Account.
privacy.s2_item_account: Whether a Notefox Account is active (true/false)
privacy.s2_item_anon_id: Anonymous user ID (a random string that does not identify you)
privacy.s2_usage: Telemetry data are used exclusively for anonymous internal statistics to analyze usability and the most used features. They are not shared with third parties and cannot identify you.
privacy.s3_intro: If enabled, Notefox may collect anonymous error logs to detect and fix bugs more effectively. This can also be enabled without a Notefox Account.
privacy.s3_usage: Error logs data are used only for debugging and technical improvement. They are anonymous, not shared with third parties, and not used for statistical or marketing purposes.
privacy.s3_retention: Error logs older than 30 days are automatically deleted from the server.
privacy.s4_text: If you notice any suspicious activity, please change your password immediately. Notefox will never ask for your password or sensitive information.
privacy.s5_text: Saverio Morelli is not responsible for any loss, corruption, or misuse of data, nor for damages caused by the use or inability to use the service. Users are fully responsible for how they use the Notefox add-on and their stored data. The developer assumes no responsibility for any illegal or unauthorized use of the service.
privacy.footnote: * Passwords and emails are encrypted using SHA-512; user data (notes, settings, etc.) are encrypted with AES-256. IP addresses are stored unencrypted.
privacy.s1_otp: Two-Factor Authentication (OTP) is enabled by default on every account. When you log in, a verification code is sent to your email. This ensures that even if your password is compromised, an attacker cannot access your account without also having access to your email inbox. OTP can be disabled from your account settings.
privacy.s1_sessions: Sessions are identified by a 64-character login-id and token pair. Sessions can optionally have an expiry date. A session without expiry stays valid until you explicitly log out or change your password. Changing the password invalidates all other sessions.
privacy.s1_v1_text: If you created your account before the v2 migration, your account may still use the v1 system. V1 uses a simpler encryption model where data is encrypted directly with a key derived from your password. V1 accounts are fully supported and can authenticate with both v1 and v2 endpoints. The v1 system does not include DEK-based encryption, sync history, or session expiry features.
privacy.s1_email_pwd_change: When you request a password change: confirmation code
privacy.s1_email_otp_change: When you change your OTP settings: notification email
privacy.s6_intro: When you use the contact form on this website, we collect the following information:
privacy.s6_item_name: Name — to address you in our response.
privacy.s6_item_email: Email address — to send you a confirmation and reply to your message.
privacy.s6_item_topic: Topic — to categorize your request (Bug, Report, Suggestion, or Other).
privacy.s6_item_version: Notefox version (optional) — to help us identify the version you are using.
privacy.s6_item_browser: Web browser — to understand the browser environment where you encountered the issue.
privacy.s6_item_os: Operating system (optional) — to help us reproduce and diagnose the issue.
privacy.s6_usage: This data is used exclusively to respond to your inquiry. We do not share it with third parties. A confirmation email is sent to the address you provide. Messages are stored only in the developer's mailbox and are not linked to any Notefox account.
privacy.s6_captcha: The contact form uses Altcha, a privacy-friendly CAPTCHA that works entirely on your device without sending personal data to third parties.
privacy.s7_text: The current Privacy Policy can be updated at any time. It is your responsibility to check it periodically.
privacy.s6_item_lang: Browser language — automatically detected from your browser settings, to help us respond in the appropriate language.
privacy.s6_item_timezone: Timezone — automatically detected from your browser settings, to understand your approximate location without using IP geolocation.
privacy.s0_text: The data controller is Saverio Morelli, an independent developer based in Italy. For any questions regarding data processing, you can use the contact form or write to the addresses listed on saveriomorelli.com.
privacy.s0b_intro: In accordance with Article 6 of the GDPR, personal data is processed on the following legal bases:
privacy.s0b_item_consent: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)) — for Telemetry and Error Logs, which are optional and require explicit user opt-in.
privacy.s0b_item_contract: Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) — for Notefox Account data, which is necessary to provide the synchronisation service.
privacy.s0b_item_interest: Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) — for IP address collection (security monitoring and rate limiting) and for contact form processing.
privacy.s1_sessions_retention: IP addresses stored alongside sessions are retained for the lifetime of the session and are deleted when the session is revoked, expires, or when the user changes their password.
privacy.s2_retention: Telemetry data are retained for a maximum of 12 months from the date of collection, after which they are automatically deleted.
privacy.s_retention_intro: The following table summarises how long each category of data is retained:
privacy.s_retention_item_account: Account data (email hash, username, encrypted notes) — until the user deletes their account.
privacy.s_retention_item_ip_creation: IP address at account creation — stored unencrypted and automatically deleted after 30 days. Also deleted immediately if the account is deleted.
privacy.s_retention_item_ip_sessions: IP addresses in sessions — until the session is revoked, expires, or the password is changed. Stored unencrypted.
privacy.s_retention_item_ip_sync: IP addresses in sync records — until the associated data or account is deleted. Stored unencrypted.
privacy.s_retention_item_rate: Rate limit records — IP addresses and emails are stored exclusively as SHA-512 hashes (never in plaintext). Expired records are automatically deleted after 7 days.
privacy.s_retention_item_history: Sync history — up to 200 versions per user; older versions are automatically pruned.
privacy.s_retention_item_contact: Contact form messages — stored only in the developer's mailbox; not linked to any Notefox account.
privacy.s_retention_deletion: Upon account deletion, all associated data — including synced notes, sync history, sessions, and stored IP addresses — are permanently and irreversibly erased from the server.
privacy.s_rights_intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.s_rights_item_access: Right of access (Art. 15) — You have the right to request confirmation of whether your personal data is being processed and to receive a copy of it.
privacy.s_rights_item_rectification: Right to rectification (Art. 16) — You have the right to request correction of inaccurate personal data.
privacy.s_rights_item_erasure: Right to erasure (Art. 17) — You have the right to request deletion of your personal data. You can delete your account at any time from your account dashboard, which permanently erases all associated data.
privacy.s_rights_item_restriction: Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18) — You have the right to request that processing of your data be restricted in certain circumstances.
privacy.s_rights_item_portability: Right to data portability (Art. 20) — You have the right to receive your data in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format (JSON). You can export your synced notes at any time from the extension or the web interface.
privacy.s_rights_item_objection: Right to object (Art. 21) — You have the right to object to data processing based on legitimate interest.
privacy.s_rights_item_withdraw: Right to withdraw consent (Art. 7(3)) — Where processing is based on consent (Telemetry, Error Logs), you can withdraw your consent at any time by disabling the respective feature in the extension settings.
privacy.s_rights_exercise: To exercise any of these rights, use the contact form or the self-service options available in the extension and the account dashboard.
privacy.s_rights_complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante per la protezione dei dati personali), Piazza Venezia 11, 00187 Roma, Italy — www.garanteprivacy.it.
privacy.s_automated_text: Notefox does not use automated decision-making or profiling as defined in Article 22 of the GDPR. Rate limiting is the only automated process and it is based solely on request frequency, not on personal characteristics.
privacy.s_transfers_text: All data is stored on servers located in Italy (Aruba.it), within the European Economic Area (EEA). No personal data is transferred outside the EEA.
privacy.en_disclaimer: This is a courtesy translation provided for informational purposes only. The legally binding version of this Privacy Policy is the Italian version. In case of any discrepancy between this English translation and the Italian original, the Italian version shall prevail.
